name: Staff of Withering

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

magic.attunement: by a Cleric, Druid, or Warlock

powers.name: Withering
powers.text: Arm it: your next hit with the staff spends 1 charge for an extra 2d10 Necrotic, and the target makes a DC 15 Con save or has Disadvantage on Strength and Constitution checks and saves for 1 hour.

summary: 3 charges: a hit can deal an extra 2d10 Necrotic and weaken the target's Strength and Constitution for an hour.
text: Swing it as a magic Quarterstaff that deals ordinary Quarterstaff damage. When it hits, you may spend 1 of its 3 charges to add 2d10 Necrotic damage; the target then rolls a Constitution saving throw against DC 15, and on a failure it has Disadvantage on Strength and Constitution ability checks and saving throws for 1 hour. The staff recovers 1d3 spent charges each dawn.
